svg.title: The planner. Five inputs: monthly salary (₹20,000 to ₹5,00,000), monthly expenses, age, one of five goals (emergency fund, buy house, travel, retirement, wealth creation) and risk appetite (low, medium, high). Worked example with the app's defaults: salary ₹50,000 and expenses ₹30,000 leave ₹20,000 available, a 40% savings rate. Emergency fund target is 6 months of expenses, ₹1,80,000. Suggested monthly investment is 80% of what is available for medium risk (60% for low, 90% for high), so ₹16,000. Investment readiness score 73 out of 100: savings rate 40 of 40 (30% or more), emergency fund progress 3 of 30 (one month of savings against the target), investment capacity 30 of 30.

div.p: Five inputs, a few plain rules. The worked example uses the app's own default profile.

div.span: Savings rate30% or more earns the full 40
Emergency fund progressone month's savings vs target
Investment capacityinvesting 80% or more of surplus
